# Simulation results (generated by src/make_figures.py)

Inputs: observed 4.0 bb/100 over 500,000 hands (self-reported). SD unknown; base case 100 bb/100.

## Part 1: interval for the true win rate

| SD (bb/100) | Std. error | 95% interval | P(true wr > 0) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 70 | 0.99 | 2.06 to 5.94 | 1.0000 |
| 80 | 1.13 | 1.78 to 6.22 | 0.9998 |
| 90 | 1.27 | 1.51 to 6.49 | 0.9992 |
| 100 | 1.41 | 1.23 to 6.77 | 0.9977 |
| 110 | 1.56 | 0.95 to 7.05 | 0.9949 |
| 120 | 1.70 | 0.67 to 7.33 | 0.9908 |
| 130 | 1.84 | 0.40 to 7.60 | 0.9852 |

Hands for a ±1 bb/100 interval at SD 100: 3,841,459

## Part 1: chance a true 4 bb/100 player is ahead (SD 100)

| Window | P(ahead) |
|---|---|
| 100 hands (one short session) | 51.6% |
| 1,000 hands | 55.0% |
| 10,000 hands | 65.5% |
| 100,000 hands | 89.7% |
| 500,000 hands | 99.8% |

|---|---|---|
| Observed win rate, 5th pct (bb/100) | 1.68 | 1.73 |
| Observed win rate, 95th pct (bb/100) | 6.23 | 6.34 |
| Largest drawdown, median (buy-ins) | 40 | 38 |
| Largest drawdown, 95th pct (buy-ins) | 69 | 71 |
| Longest break-even stretch, median (hands) | 95,600 | 93,200 |
| Longest break-even stretch, 95th pct (hands) | 237,410 | 229,730 |

## Part 2: risk of ruin at a fixed stake (SD 100)

| Bankroll (buy-ins) | Point estimate (4) | Averaged over uncertainty | Lower end (1.23) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 | 20.2% | 23.6% | 61.2% |
| 30 | 9.1% | 12.9% | 47.9% |
| 50 | 1.8% | 4.8% | 29.3% |
| 100 | 0.0% | 1.1% | 8.6% |

Full Kelly bankroll at 4.0 bb/100: 25 buy-ins; half Kelly: 50 buy-ins.
